name: Reaper's Goodbye
source:
It’s just the wheels of fate turning– You all just got caught in the spokes. 

Deep within the countryside under a wide, open sky, it is said those holding considerable misfortune will inevitably cross paths. Stories of promise, regret, revenge and longing are traded like precious treasures before disappearing into the night. And a special few watch from the shadows...

At food stall serving lost souls, five troubled patrons tell their tales of woe while waiting for the midnight train.

Six strangers, five stories, and one final farewell!

[From [url=https://kale-chips.itch.io/reapers-goodbye]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不過是命運之輪在轉動——而你們都被捲進了輻條之間。

廣闊天空之下，鄉野深處，據說背負巨大不幸的人們終會相遇。承諾、遺憾、復仇與渴望的故事，像珍寶一樣被交換，又消失在夜色中。還有少數特殊的存在，從陰影裡注視著一切……

在一家為迷途靈魂提供食物的小攤前，五位心事重重的客人一邊等候午夜列車，一邊講述各自的悲傷往事。

六個陌生人，五段故事，以及一場最後的告別！

[摘自[url=https://kale-chips.itch.io/reapers-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
